setup.title: LiwanOS setup
setup.description: Five short steps to get your company ready. Open the right page, then mark the step done or skip it.

company.title: Company details
company.purpose: Your company name, logo and address appear on invoices and messages.

sector.title: Company activity
sector.purpose: Note what fits your activity before you adjust the apps.

channels.title: Contact channels
channels.purpose: Connect a WhatsApp number or another channel so customers can reach your team.

team.title: Team
team.purpose: Add your colleagues and choose what each of them can do.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.purpose: Add your existing customers so they are ready in every app.

notes.none: This step has no page yet. Mark it done or skip it.
notes.feature: This app is not included in your plan. You can skip the step.
notes.permission: You do not have permission to open this page. You can skip the step.

closed.title: Setup is finished
closed.description: The setup card no longer shows on the home page. You can reopen it any time.

setup.failed: The change could not be saved. Try again.

home.title: Finish setting up your company
home.description: A few steps are left to get LiwanOS ready for your team.
